# EjectSeat

> EjectSeat is a live feed of US public-company layoffs and restructurings, read directly from SEC EDGAR filings (Form 8-K, Item 2.05), plus a forward-looking layoff risk checker.

## Key pages
- [Latest layoffs](https://ejectseat.io/layoffs): every Item 2.05 filing of the last 60 days, with % of workforce, jobs, charges and a link to the filing
- [RSS feed](https://ejectseat.io/layoffs/feed.xml)
- [How we source layoff news](https://ejectseat.io/about): coverage, limits and corrections
- [WARN notices](https://ejectseat.io/warn): state layoff notices from Texas and Maryland, including private companies
- [Risk checker](https://ejectseat.io/check.html): forward-looking layoff risk score for a US-listed company
- Company history: https://ejectseat.io/layoffs/{TICKER} (for example /layoffs/WDAY)

## Notes for citation
- Figures are stated by the company in its SEC filing; each item links to the source filing.
- Risk scores are estimates, not facts, and not investment advice.
